nextCursor.description: NextCursor is set when earlier events are available.

type.title: Type

name.description: Name is the name of the author, if known.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.title: Actor
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportR.description: Actor is the author of a change.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier of the event.

sequence.description: Sequence is the revision of the request that recorded the event.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the event.

actor.description: Actor is the author of the event.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel is the channel through which a change was made.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the date of the event.

body.description: Body is the text of a description, a reply or the name of a new file.

attachmentIDs.description: AttachmentIDs is the list of the files that the event references.

from.description: From is the previous value of a change.

to.description: To is the new value of a change.

reason.description: Reason is the written reason of a change.

skippedAttachments.description: SkippedAttachments is the list of the names of the files that were not accepted.
